The '''Dulan Field Harvesting Center''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rinagom]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It served as the administrative center of the planet and the headquarters of its [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Cray Linlok]]. Off-world material deliveries were directed to land at this site.<ref name="KtP" />
